General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: - Model toilets installed (146 families) that are protected from inundation and from which the waste can be used as bio manure. These model toilets generated great interest and steps are taken to replicate the model. Low cost waste disposal pits introduced. Reduced instances of open defecation has improved health status of the communities. - Surface water treatment plant set up as model to demonstrate alternative to dependance on ground water reserves. 1200 school children and nearby household get water from the facility. - Rainwaterharvesting structures put up, maintenance of water bodies introduced, groundwater purification unit installed, impregnated bed nets distributed, schoolchildren trained in - Impregnated bed nets distributed, school children trained in water monitoring, WASH and DRR. - Disaster resilient farming practice introduced and mangrove planted. - District and local level consultations and involvment of stakeholders.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
